templates.pattern: In 6×6 Sudoku, row has [A], [B], ?, [C], [D], [E]. Uses 1-6. What's position 3?
templates.explanation: Row uses 1-6 (sum=21). Missing = 21 - [A] - [B] - [C] - [D] - [E]

templates.pattern: Cell constraints: Row has [A], [B]. Column has [C]. Uses 1-4. What fits the cell?
templates.explanation: Uses 1-4 (sum=10). Row blocks [A],[B]. Column blocks [C]. Missing = 10 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Box has [A], [B], [C], [D], ?, ?, ?, ?, ?. Uses 1-9. Sum of missing 5 numbers?
templates.explanation: Box uses 1-9 (sum=45). Has [A], [B], [C], [D]. Missing sum = 45 - A - B - C - D

templates.pattern: X-Sudoku: Main diagonal has [A], ?, [B], [C]. Uses 1-4. No repeats. What's position 2?
templates.explanation: Diagonal uses 1-4 once. Missing = 10 - [A] - [B] - [C]

templates.pattern: Row has [A], [B], [C], ?. Sum must be [SUM]. What's the missing number?
templates.explanation: Row sum is [SUM]. Has [A], [B], [C]. Missing = [SUM] - [A] - [B] - [C]

templates.pattern: Row needs 3 or [B]. Column needs [B] or 4. What's at intersection?
templates.explanation: Row needs 3 or [B]. Column needs [B] or 4. Common is [B]

templates.pattern: Box has [A], [B], [C], ?, ?, ?. Uses 1-6. What's the sum of missing 3?
templates.explanation: Box uses 1-6 (sum=21). Has [A], [B], [C]. Missing sum = 21 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Main diagonal has [A], ?, [B], [C], [D], [E], [F], [G], [H]. Uses 1-9. What's position 2?
templates.calculation: 45 - A - B - C - D - E - F - G - H
templates.explanation: Diagonal uses 1-9 (sum=45). Missing = 45 - all given

templates.pattern: Cell blocked by row ([A]), column ([B]), box ([C]). Uses 1-4. What fits?
templates.explanation: Row has [A], column has [B], box has [C]. Remaining = 10 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Box has [A], [B], [C], ?. Uses 1-4. What completes box?
templates.explanation: Box has [A],[B],[C]. Missing = 10 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Cell must be [N] + 1. Column blocks [A]. Uses 1-9. What works?
templates.explanation: Must be [N] + 1. That equals N + 1

templates.pattern: Cell must be odd and > [X]. Row blocks [A]. Uses 1-9. What odd number fits?
templates.explanation: Odd numbers > [X]. Row blocks even [A]. Next odd after [X] is X + 2

templates.pattern: Overlapping grids. Grid1 row blocks [A]. Grid2 column blocks [B]. Uses 1-9. Overlap cell = ?
templates.explanation: Grid1 blocks [A]. Grid2 blocks [B]. Cell needs different number, smallest is 7

templates.pattern: Arrow sum: Circle = [A] + [B]. What's circle value?
templates.explanation: Circle = sum of arrow cells [A] + [B]

templates.pattern: Thermometer: [A] < ? < [C]. What fits middle?
templates.explanation: Must be between [A] and [C]. Middle value is A + 2

templates.pattern: Sandwich: Sum between 1 and 9 is [SUM]. Has [B], [C]. What's third number?
templates.explanation: Sum is [SUM]. Has [B] and [C]. Missing = [SUM] - [B] - [C]

templates.pattern: Cell A = [X]. Cell B must be < A. B can be 3, 4, or 5. Which B works if A = [X]?
templates.explanation: [X] is at least 6. B must be < [X]. Among 3,4,5, answer is 4

templates.pattern: Anti-Knight blocks [N]. Cell must be [N] + 2. What's the cell value?
templates.explanation: Anti-knight blocks [N]. Cell is [N] + 2

templates.pattern: Kropki white: consecutive. Cell A = [VAL]. Adjacent must be VAL + 1. What's adjacent?
templates.explanation: White dot = consecutive. Adjacent = [VAL] + 1

templates.pattern: XV sum = 10. Cell A = [VAL]. What's the other cell?
templates.explanation: X means sum is 10. [VAL] + ? = 10. So ? = 10 - [VAL]

templates.pattern: Clone grids identical. Grid1 position = [A]. Grid2 same position = ?
templates.explanation: Clone grids identical. Grid1 has [A], so Grid2 has [A]

templates.pattern: Box has [A], [B], [C], ?. Uses 1-4. What's missing?
templates.explanation: Box has [A],[B],[C]. Missing = 10 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Irregular region has [A], [B], [C], [D], ?. Uses 1-5. What completes?
templates.explanation: Region uses 1-5 (sum=15). Missing = 15 - [A] - [B] - [C] - [D]

templates.pattern: Jigsaw region has [A], [B], ?, [D], [E], [F]. Uses 1-6. What's position 3?
templates.explanation: Region uses 1-6 (sum=21). Missing = 21 - [A] - [B] - [D] - [E] - [F]

templates.pattern: Cell must be > [X] and odd. Column blocks [A]. Uses 1-9. What works?
templates.explanation: Must be odd and > [X]. Column blocks [A]. Next odd after [X] is X + 2
